summary: First full test pass of GENOVA AI Step A. Backend: the existing 68-test suite passes (pytest -n 0). I added a live e2e suite that runs against the public preview URL with real Clerk tokens (17 tests, all pass). It covers public endpoints, 401s, all 6 calculators with scientific checks, localized 400/422/404 errors, re-localization by id, data isolation between two users, 403 on /api/users and delete-then-404. I also checked by hand: rate limit (30/min, then 429), invalid lang (422), unknown disease and invalid status (localized 400), and non-object body (422). Frontend, run with Playwright on desktop and mobile with a Clerk ticket sign-in: landing page with hero and tier legend, the public Sources page with draft badges and references, protected-route redirect, session kept after refresh, a dashboard with 6 cards, and every calculator form showing the correct result card. This included the Punnett grid, X-linked results split by sex, blood-type ranges plus impossible types, the genotype entry mode, G6PD 'heterozygous variable', beta-thal carrier x unknown with scenarios and the population-unavailable message, Tanner height 179 (170.5-187.5)/166, qualitative pigmentation bands and sex ratio 21/41. EN/AR/DE switching flips dir to rtl and re-localizes a result already on screen. History list, the detail page in German, delete and 404 after delete, and sign-out all work. No functional bugs found; only minor UX, copy and design notes.

minor.issue: _clerk_user uses blocking requests.get inside an async dependency (first request per user only). It blocks the event loop for up to 10s. Use httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool.
The rate limiter runs before payload validation, so invalid requests also count toward the 30/min quota. The limiter is in-memory per worker (documented).

ui_bugs.issue: Delete runs in one click with no confirm dialog and no error handling: remove() has no try/catch, so a failure shows no toast and causes an unhandled promise rejection.

issues: The 'Each son' and 'Each daughter' groups are separate auto-width tables, so the fraction and bar columns don't line up between groups (seen in EN and AR). Use fixed column widths.
Copy reads 'If mother is Aa if father is Aa'. It is missing 'and' or a comma (EN).
Internal data-entry notes such as 'country figures to extract' and 'To extract from Table 1' are shown to users. These region notes are English-only, even in AR and DE.
After sign-out the user lands on /sign-in, not the landing page. Optional: set afterSignOutUrl='/'.
Mendelian and blood entries show no summary of the inputs (mode or genotypes), so several 'Single-gene inheritance' rows look the same.

action_items: (Low) Add a confirm dialog and try/catch with an error toast to history delete
(Low) Fix the scenario sentence copy ('If mother is X and father is Y')
(Low) Hide or translate the internal draft notes in regional sources
(Low) Make the Clerk user lookup non-blocking (async httpx)
critical_code_review_comments: Carrier 'carrier_conditional' (unknown parent) is badged 'Established (Mendelian)'. Each scenario is exact, but the overall answer depends on an unknown status. Consider a clearer label so users don't read it as a definitive risk.
useAnalysis refetch on language change swallows errors silently (.catch(() => {})). This is acceptable, but stale-language results can appear without notice.
AnalysisDetailPage treats any error (including network or 401) as '404'.
Files are small and well modularized; _id is excluded properly; env vars are used; pydantic uses extra=forbid. Good.
test_credentials: genova.tester+clerk_test@example.com (member) and genova.other+clerk_test@example.com (member, created in Clerk for isolation tests). Sessions come from /app/scripts/clerk_test_session.py.
seed_data_creation: Created the Clerk user genova.other+clerk_test@example.com. I deleted all analyses I created during testing by id or by my session's time window; 3 pre-existing analyses of the main tester were left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests -n 0` (unit tests plus test_live_api_e2e.py, which mints real Clerk tokens through the script). UI sign-in: open /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<ticket>; every browser session needs a new ticket. Clerk sign out: click '[data-testid=user-menu] button', then 'button:has-text("Sign out")'. The analysis rate limit is 30/min per user, so spread heavy UI runs over time or use the second user.
